+--
+--  SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception
+--
+
+--  Monotone radix heap for non-negative integer keys.
+--
+--  Bucket 0 contains keys equal to Base. Bucket B > 0 contains keys whose
+--  distance from Base has bit length B. Insertions must not go backwards:
+--  K >= Base. Extraction advances Base to the minimum key, redistributes the
+--  first non-empty bucket, and removes one key from bucket 0.
+
+pragma Assertion_Policy (Ghost          => Ignore,
+                         Pre            => Ignore,
+                         Post           => Ignore,
+                         Assert         => Ignore,
+                         Loop_Invariant => Ignore);
+
+with Heaps.Key_Multisets;
+with Heaps.Models;
+with SPARK.Big_Integers;
+
+package Heaps.Radix with SPARK_Mode is
+
+   use type Key_Multisets.Multiset;
+   use type SPARK.Big_Integers.Big_Integer;
+
+   subtype Bucket_Index is Natural range 0 .. Key_Type'Size - 1;
+
+   type Link is record
+      Prev   : Extended_Index := 0;
+      Next   : Extended_Index := 0;
+      Length : Extended_Index := 0;
+   end record;
+
+   type Link_Array is array (Index range <>) of Link;
+   type Bucket_Array is array (Bucket_Index) of Extended_Index
+     with Default_Component_Value => 0;
+
+   type Heap (Capacity : Extended_Index) is record
+      Last   : Extended_Index := 0;
+      Base   : Key_Type := 0;
+      Keys   : Key_Array (1 .. Capacity);
+      Links  : Link_Array (1 .. Capacity);
+      Heads  : Bucket_Array;
+      Counts : Bucket_Array;
+   end record
+     with Predicate => Last <= Capacity and Base >= 0;
+
+   function Bucket_Of (K, Base : Key_Type) return Bucket_Index
+     with Pre  => Base >= 0 and then K >= Base,
+          Post => (Bucket_Of'Result = 0) = (K = Base);
+
+   function Model (H : Heap) return Key_Multisets.Multiset is
+     (Models.Occurrences (H.Keys, H.Last))
+     with Ghost;
+
+   function Total_From (H : Heap; B : Bucket_Index)
+                        return SPARK.Big_Integers.Big_Natural is
+     (SPARK.Big_Integers.To_Big_Integer (H.Counts (B))
+      + (if B = Bucket_Index'Last
+         then 0
+         else Total_From (H, Bucket_Index'Succ (B))))
+     with Ghost,
+          Subprogram_Variant => (Increases => B);
+
+   function Bucket_Valid (H : Heap; B : Bucket_Index) return Boolean is
+     ((if H.Counts (B) = 0
+         then H.Heads (B) = 0
+         else H.Heads (B) in 1 .. H.Last
+              and then Bucket_Of (H.Keys (H.Heads (B)), H.Base) = B
+              and then H.Links (H.Heads (B)).Prev = 0
+              and then H.Links (H.Heads (B)).Length = H.Counts (B)))
+     with Ghost;
+
+   function Node_Valid (H : Heap; I : Index) return Boolean is
+     (H.Keys (I) >= H.Base
+      and then H.Links (I).Length
+                 in 1 .. H.Counts (Bucket_Of (H.Keys (I), H.Base))
+      and then H.Links (I).Prev in 0 .. H.Last
+      and then H.Links (I).Next in 0 .. H.Last
+      and then
+        (if H.Links (I).Prev = 0
+         then H.Heads (Bucket_Of (H.Keys (I), H.Base)) = I
+              and then H.Links (I).Length
+                         = H.Counts (Bucket_Of (H.Keys (I), H.Base))
+         else Bucket_Of (H.Keys (H.Links (I).Prev), H.Base)
+                    = Bucket_Of (H.Keys (I), H.Base)
+              and then H.Links (H.Links (I).Prev).Next = I
+              and then H.Links (H.Links (I).Prev).Length
+                         = H.Links (I).Length + 1)
+      and then
+        (if H.Links (I).Next = 0
+         then H.Links (I).Length = 1
+         else Bucket_Of (H.Keys (H.Links (I).Next), H.Base)
+                    = Bucket_Of (H.Keys (I), H.Base)
+              and then H.Links (H.Links (I).Next).Prev = I
+              and then H.Links (H.Links (I).Next).Length + 1
+                         = H.Links (I).Length))
+     with Ghost,
+          Pre => I <= H.Last;
+
+   function Is_Heap (H : Heap) return Boolean is
+     ((for all B in Bucket_Index => Bucket_Valid (H, B))
+      and then (for all I in 1 .. H.Last => Node_Valid (H, I))
+      and then Total_From (H, Bucket_Index'First)
+                 = SPARK.Big_Integers.To_Big_Integer (H.Last))
+     with Ghost;
+
+   function Is_Minimum (H : Heap; K : Key_Type) return Boolean is
+     (for all I in 1 .. H.Last => K <= H.Keys (I))
+     with Ghost;
+
+   function Size (H : Heap) return Extended_Index is (H.Last);
+   function Is_Empty (H : Heap) return Boolean is (H.Last = 0);
+   function Is_Full (H : Heap) return Boolean is (H.Last = H.Capacity);
+
+   procedure Clear (H : in out Heap)
+     with Post => Is_Empty (H)
+                  and Is_Heap (H)
+                  and H.Base = 0
+                  and Key_Multisets.Is_Empty (Model (H));
+
+   function Peek_Min (H : Heap) return Key_Type
+     with Pre  => not Is_Empty (H) and then Is_Heap (H),
+          Post => Is_Minimum (H, Peek_Min'Result);
+
+   procedure Insert (H : in out Heap; K : Key_Type)
+     with Pre  => not Is_Full (H)
+                  and then Is_Heap (H)
+                  and then K >= H.Base,
+          Post => Is_Heap (H)
+                  and Size (H) = Size (H)'Old + 1
+                  and H.Base = H.Base'Old
+                  and Model (H) = Key_Multisets.Add (Model (H)'Old, K);
+
+   procedure Meld (Into : in out Heap; From : in out Heap)
+     with Pre  => Is_Heap (Into)
+                  and then Is_Heap (From)
+                  and then Size (From) <= Into.Capacity - Size (Into)
+                  and then From.Base >= Into.Base,
+          Post => Is_Heap (Into)
+                  and Size (Into) = Size (Into)'Old + Size (From)'Old
+                  and Into.Base = Into.Base'Old
+                  and Is_Empty (From)
+                  and Is_Heap (From)
+                  and Model (Into) = Model (Into)'Old + Model (From)'Old;
+
+   procedure Extract_Min (H : in out Heap; K : out Key_Type)
+     with Pre  => not Is_Empty (H) and then Is_Heap (H),
+          Post => Is_Heap (H)
+                  and Size (H) = Size (H)'Old - 1
+                  and K = Peek_Min (H)'Old
+                  and H.Base = K
+                  and H.Base >= H.Base'Old
+                  and Is_Minimum (H'Old, K)
+                  and Model (H)'Old = Key_Multisets.Add (Model (H), K);
+
+end Heaps.Radix;
